name: 铁壁守卫
title: 坚不可摧之盾
description: 身披重甲、手持大盾的防御型战士。擅长承受伤害并保护队友。
passiveDescription: 回合结束时保留25%护甲（向上取整）
description_en: A heavily armored defensive warrior. Excels at taking damage and protecting allies.
passiveDescription_en: Retain 25% of Armor at end of turn (rounded up).

name: 影刃刺客
title: 暗影中的利刃
description: 身法敏捷的刺客，擅长用闪避规避攻击，并在暗影中发动致命一击。
passiveDescription: 每回合首张攻击牌伤害+50%
description_en: A swift assassin who dodges enemy attacks and strikes from the shadows with deadly precision.
passiveDescription_en: First Attack card each turn deals +50% damage.

name: 生命贤者
title: 自然之息的守护者
description: 以生命为代价释放毁灭性力量的贤者，高风险高回报的输出型治疗者。
passiveDescription: 每回合结束时回复3点生命值
description_en: A sage who wields the power of life. Specializes in healing and sustained combat.
passiveDescription_en: At end of each turn, restore 3 HP.

name: 太极武僧
title: 以柔克刚的大师
description: 精通太极之道的武僧，擅长借力打力、以柔克刚。
passiveDescription: 每回合开始获得5点护甲。
description_en: A monk who uses the power of Tai Chi to counter enemies with minimal effort.
passiveDescription_en: Gain 5 armor at the start of each turn.

name: 圣光战士
title: 绝境中的曙光
description: 被圣光眷顾的战士，生命垂危时能爆发出惊人的力量。
passiveDescription: 生命低于40%时攻击伤害翻倍
description_en: A warrior blessed by holy light. Becomes stronger when critically injured.
passiveDescription_en: When HP is below 40%, Attack cards deal +100% damage.

name: 游侠商人
title: 万物皆有价
description: 拥有无尽财富的商人，能将金币转化为各种力量。
passiveDescription: 战斗结束获得额外75%金币
description_en: A merchant who wields gold as a weapon. The more gold you have, the stronger you become.
passiveDescription_en: Gain 75% extra gold from enemy rewards.

activeSkill.name: 挥金如雨
activeSkill.description: 消耗1点能量与最多40金币，对选定敌人造成消耗金币2倍的伤害
activeSkill.description_en: Spend 1 energy and up to 40 gold to deal 2x spent gold as damage to the selected enemy.

name: 亡灵祭司
title: 死亡的领路人
description: 掌控死亡之力的祭司，击杀敌人后能获得额外收益。
passiveDescription: 每次献祭后获得1层强化。
description_en: An undead priest who drains life from enemies. Each kill makes you more powerful.

name: 狂战士
title: 嗜血的怒火
description: 在战斗中越战越狂的战士，怒火积累到极限便会爆发狂暴。
passiveDescription: 受到伤害+10怒气，每打出一张攻击牌+15怒气；怒气满100自动进入狂暴状态（持续3回合）。
description_en: A warrior who grows fiercer in battle. When rage peaks, he erupts into Berserk.
passiveDescription_en: +10 Rage when hit, +15 Rage per attack card; at 100 Rage, auto-enter Berserk (lasts 3 turns).

name: 元素法师
title: 火冰雷的刻印者
description: 专精火、冰、雷三系状态法术的法师，依靠灼烧、虚弱和麻痹压制敌人。
passiveDescription: 火牌额外施加1层灼烧（持续2回合）；冰牌额外施加1层虚弱（持续2回合）；雷牌额外施加1层麻痹（持续1回合）。
description_en: A mage specializing in fire, ice, and lightning status magic, suppressing enemies with Burn, Weak, and Paralyze.
passiveDescription_en: Fire cards apply +1 Burn (lasts 2 turns); Ice cards apply +1 Weak (lasts 2 turns); Lightning cards apply +1 Paralyze (lasts 1 turn).

name: 全能贤者
title: 全能的智者
description: 掌握回响之力的全能贤者，卡牌可触发回响获得双倍效果。
passiveDescription: 每回合开始获得1层回响。
description_en: A sage who masters the power of echoes. Playing a card consumes 1 Echo to double its effects.
passiveDescription_en: Gain 1 Echo at the start of each turn.

name: 格斗大师
title: 连击的艺术
description: 精通近身格斗的大师，连击次数越多伤害越高。
passiveDescription: 每次攻击命中获得1层连击。
description_en: A master of close combat. Combos deal more damage the more cards you play.

name: 冰霜祭司
title: 凛冬的祝福
description: 掌握冰霜之力的祭司，既能治疗队友又能冰冻敌人。
description_en: A priest who commands ice magic and draws strength from freezing enemies.
passiveDescription_en: Draw 1 card whenever an enemy is Frozen.

name: 荆棘守卫
title: 越战越强的堡垒
description: 身披荆棘之甲的守卫，受到的伤害会转化为反击力量。
passiveDescription: 受到攻击时（含护甲吸收部分）反弹30%伤害给攻击者。
description_en: A guardian covered in thorns. Reflects damage back at attackers.
passiveDescription_en: Reflect 30% of incoming attack damage (including damage absorbed by armor) back to the attacker.

name: 吞噬者
title: 无尽饥饿的深渊
description: 以吞噬敌人为生的深渊造物，残血敌人无法逃脱它的血盆大口。
passiveDescription: 攻击后敌人生命低于15%时直接吞噬斩杀，回复其最大生命15%，永久获得2点生命上限。
description_en: An abyssal being that feeds on enemies. Low-HP foes cannot escape its maw.
passiveDescription_en: After attacking, enemies below 15% HP are devoured instantly. Heal 15% of their max HP and permanently gain 2 max HP.

name: 创造者
title: 超越维度的存在
description: 开发者模式下的测试角色，掌握创世之力。
